usage: tunnel recordings import [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] [--replace] DIR

positional arguments:
  DIR          a directory `tunnel recordings export` wrote

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --base BASE  where the admin API answers (default http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json       print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
  --replace    empty each session before importing into it
